verses.en: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.sm: Atua; ua faaalia foi e le va nimonimo le galuega a ona aao.

verses.en: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
verses.sm: O loo tatu atu le upu e le tasi aso i le tasi aso, o loc faailoa foi le poto e le tasi po i le tasi po.

verses.en: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
verses.sm: E leai se gagana, e leai foi ni upu, e le lagona o latou leo.

verses.en: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.sm: Ca oo atu lo latou leo i le lalolagi uma lava, ma a latou upu i tuluiga o le atu laulau. Ua na tuu i ai le fale ie mo le la;

verses.en: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
verses.sm: o ia foi, e faapei o se faatoafaiava ua sau mai lona afeafe; e 6aua o ia e pei o se tagata fitafita e tamo'e i le ala.

verses.en: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.sm: O lona alu atu, mai le tasi tuluiga o le lagi lea, ua 00 foi lana faataamilosaga i le tasi ona tuluiga; e lezi foi se mea e lilo i lona vevela.

verses.en: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.sm: Esao le tulafono a le ALII, e faafoisia mai ai le agaga; e faamaoni poloaiga a le ALI, e faapotoina ai le ua faigofie.

verses.en: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.sm: Etonu feau a le ALII, e faafiafia ai le loto; e mama poloaiga a le ALII, e malamalama ai mata.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.
verses.sm: E mama le mataʻu i le ALII, e tumau e faavavau; o faamasinoga foi a le ALII E moni ia ma tonu uma lava.

verses.en: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.sm: 11 12 13 SALAMO 19,20 E silisili ona lelei i le auro, o le auro e sili ona lelei e tele; e sili foi ona suamalie i lo le meli,

verses.en: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.sm: o le meli ua sisina ifo. Ua apoapoaiina mai ai foi lau auauna;

verses.en: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
verses.sm: e tele foi le taui pe a tausi i ai. O ai ea na te iloa amio sese?

verses.en: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verses.sm: la e faamagalo ia te au i agasala lilo. Ia e taofi foi i lau auauna i agasala faamaualuga; aua neʻi pule ia ia te au; ona sao ai lea o laʻu amio, ou te le nofo sala foi i le leaga sili.

verses.en: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.sm: Ta malie foi ia te oe upu a lo'u gutu, ma mafaufauga o lo‘u loto, le Aw: e, loʻu papa ma le na te togiolaina aʻu.
